name: Chef pony
tips: `sudo` runs one command as root, the administrator. It asks your password: that command can change the whole system.
This joke comes from xkcd comic 149: "make me a sandwich" fails, and "sudo make me a sandwich" works.
Only use `sudo` when a command really needs it. As root, small mistakes become big ones.
personal: Okay. One sandwich. Because you said sudo.
A perfect sandwich takes the right ingredients, in the right order.
Don't touch my kitchen without sudo.
